name: Delicate Instruments

angles.text: As a mage, you know the Tower of Azora's delicate apparatus needs steady surroundings. Crude geomantic magic can disrupt careful arcane study.
As an Alliance member, you can help protect Elwynn Forest's scholarly enclaves by aiding the researchers at the Tower of Azora against the kobolds' disruptive magic.

faq.answer: Hamish Bergwort is an arcane researcher at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. His sensitive instruments need precise calibration and are easily disturbed by magical fluctuations.
Magical surges from Jasperlode Mine to the north disrupt the instruments. Kobolds there create the surges with crude earth magic.
faq.q: Why are the arcane instruments malfunctioning?

faq.answer: Jasperlode Mine lies north of the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. Kobolds occupy its tunnels, where geomantic rituals send ripples through the surrounding woods.
Kobold geomancers are spellcasters among the kobold packs who wield crude elemental earth magic. Their rituals together create disturbances that interfere with sensitive arcane equipment.
Stopping the geomancers' rituals in Jasperlode Mine ends the elemental surges. Then researchers at the Tower of Azora can calibrate their devices without interference.
faq.q: How does eliminating the geomancers resolve the issue?

faq.answer: The Tower of Azora is an arcane study spire in eastern Elwynn Forest. Scholars and mages there observe regional phenomena and maintain finely tuned magical apparatus.
faq.q: What is the Tower of Azora?

sections.body: At the Tower of Azora, Hamish Bergwort's arcane apparatus needs careful calibration. Uncontrolled surges keep unsettling his measurements. He cannot make precise adjustments while the interference continues.
sections.title: Disrupted Calibrations

sections.body: The magical pulses lead north to Jasperlode Mine. Kobolds have taken its tunnels, where their geomancers work crude earth magic. Their frequent rituals send ripples through the stone. Those tremors unsettle the Tower of Azora's sensitive instruments.
sections.title: The Interference from Jasperlode

summary: Hamish Bergwort's instruments at the Tower of Azora falter as surges of magic rise from the north. Their source is Jasperlode Mine, where kobold geomancers stir the earth.
